g.text: Title: Control panel - the climate unit's face (D-492)

g.desc: Title: Control panel - the climate unit's face (D-492)

g.text: Drawn from the record: 02-PROJECTS/01-electrical/data/panel_ribbon.csv, cavities DP-DCU-E, dcu_channels SN17-SN20, parts P155 P192 P201. Where this sheet and a row disagree, the row is right.

g.desc: Drawn from the record: 02-PROJECTS/01-electrical/data/panel_ribbon.csv, cavities DP-DCU-E, dcu_channels SN17-SN20, parts P155 P192 P201. Where this sheet and a row disagree, the row is right.

g.text: No processor, no CAN node, no 12 V (D-355); the ribbon's +5 V and I2C serve the lights and the screen (D-458, D-492). Positions and looks are the faceplate's (luxury LP20).

g.desc: No processor, no CAN node, no 12 V (D-355); the ribbon's +5 V and I2C serve the lights and the screen (D-458, D-492). Positions and looks are the faceplate's (luxury LP20).

g.text: R11: nothing here has been measured or bought. Rev 0.04 (Y20, D-492): the sketch's control set - centre encoder with push, screen, four keys, two window switches, two seat knobs, plate header.

g.desc: R11: nothing here has been measured or bought. Rev 0.04 (Y20, D-492): the sketch's control set - centre encoder with push, screen, four keys, two window switches, two seat knobs, plate header.

g.text: Rev 0.03 (Y6, D-458, D-459) had nine keys on 3 x 3, four encoders and the thumbstick (D-380, superseded).

g.desc: Rev 0.03 (Y6, D-458, D-459) had nine keys on 3 x 3, four encoders and the thumbstick (D-380, superseded).

g.text: Seats: OFF in the middle, clockwise heat 1-3, anticlockwise cool 1-3 (D-073, I-003); no push.

g.desc: Seats: OFF in the middle, clockwise heat 1-3, anticlockwise cool 1-3 (D-073, I-003); no push.

g.text: ROW1: rear defog (here) - hatch, fuel door (left plate, through J3 1-3) ROW2: HVAC mode - recirculate - window DRV up

g.desc: ROW1: rear defog (here) - hatch, fuel door (left plate, through J3 1-3) ROW2: HVAC mode - recirculate - window DRV up

g.text: to its VCC must not run at 5 V on this bus (the Teensy's pins are 3.3 V): bridge 2-3 or remove them - confirm (P201).

g.desc: to its VCC must not run at 5 V on this bus (the Teensy's pins are 3.3 V): bridge 2-3 or remove them - confirm (P201).

g.text: JP1 picks its supply: 1-2 +5V_PNL (the record: +3V3 feeds only the stick) or 2-3 +3V3. A module whose I2C pull-ups go

g.desc: JP1 picks its supply: 1-2 +5V_PNL (the record: +3V3 feeds only the stick) or 2-3 +3V3. A module whose I2C pull-ups go

g.text: window PASS up: ROW3 / COL2 (pole 1) down: ROW3 / COL3 (pole 2)

g.desc: window PASS up: ROW3 / COL2 (pole 1) down: ROW3 / COL3 (pole 2)

g.text: R1 10 k sets IMAX = 58.5 x 1.3 V / 10 k = 7.6 mA (p.11); R2 100 k holds SDB high so the chip is on and blank until written.

g.desc: R1 10 k sets IMAX = 58.5 x 1.3 V / 10 k = 7.6 mA (p.11); R2 100 k holds SDB high so the chip is on and blank until written.

g.text: Headlight-only lights (the ring, the window and seat symbols) and state lights (the key symbols, the seat arcs) differ only in firmware (I-004).

g.desc: Headlight-only lights (the ring, the window and seat symbols) and state lights (the key symbols, the seat arcs) differ only in firmware (I-004).

g.text: J1: the 26-way ribbon to the DCU carrier's J4, pinned as panel_ribbon (P157, D-458, D-492).

g.desc: J1: the 26-way ribbon to the DCU carrier's J4, pinned as panel_ribbon (P157, D-458, D-492).

g.text: J2 takes the module's own 4-pin header, GND - VCC - SCL - SDA (the common order, confirm on the module bought).

g.desc: J2 takes the module's own 4-pin header, GND - VCC - SCL - SDA (the common order, confirm on the module bought).

g.text: SCREEN - a 128 x 64-class I2C module on the panel bus (P201, D-492)

g.desc: SCREEN - a 128 x 64-class I2C module on the panel bus (P201, D-492)

g.text: LIGHTS - IS31FL3236A, I2C 0x3C (AD to GND), 36 constant-current sinks; each LED anode on +5V_PNL (D-458, D-492)

g.desc: LIGHTS - IS31FL3236A, I2C 0x3C (AD to GND), 36 constant-current sinks; each LED anode on +5V_PNL (D-458, D-492)

g.text: J3: the left plate's twelve lines, DP-DCU-E 1-12 pin for pin, by a lead to the upper board's J8 (D-492, Y21).

g.desc: J3: the left plate's twelve lines, DP-DCU-E 1-12 pin for pin, by a lead to the upper board's J8 (D-492, Y21).

g.text: The window switches are centre-sprung DPDT: one pole per direction, so DRV up (ROW2/COL3) and DRV down (ROW3/COL1)

g.desc: The window switches are centre-sprung DPDT: one pole per direction, so DRV up (ROW2/COL3) and DRV down (ROW3/COL1)

g.text: are two independent keys; an SPDT's single common cannot reach two rows and two columns without a phantom key.

g.desc: are two independent keys; an SPDT's single common cannot reach two rows and two columns without a phantom key.

g.text: Centre: temperature; a push sets fan speed until it rests; fan mode after the fan-mode key (I-001).

g.desc: Centre: temperature; a push sets fan speed until it rests; fan mode after the fan-mode key (I-001).

g.text: KEYS - 4 x 3 matrix, one 1N4148W per key, cathode to the row: a driven-low row pulls its column low (D-492)

g.desc: KEYS - 4 x 3 matrix, one 1N4148W per key, cathode to the row: a driven-low row pulls its column low (D-492)

g.text: KNOBS - detented quadrature encoders, common to GND (D-355, D-492)

g.desc: KNOBS - detented quadrature encoders, common to GND (D-355, D-492)

g.text: window DRV up: ROW2 / COL3 (pole 1) down: ROW3 / COL1 (pole 2)

g.desc: window DRV up: ROW2 / COL3 (pole 1) down: ROW3 / COL1 (pole 2)

g.text: POWER - ribbon only: +5V_PNL behind the carrier's PTC F1, +3V3 for the stick (D-458, D-492)

g.desc: POWER - ribbon only: +5V_PNL behind the carrier's PTC F1, +3V3 for the stick (D-458, D-492)
